summary: Avalo Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies for an at-the-market program of up to $200 million of common stock under its effective Form S-3. Jefferies receives up to 3.0% commission and acts as sales agent at the company's discretion, with no obligation to sell. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM facility, not a special situation; the Item 1.02 reference is boilerplate. Watch share-price dilution and any utilization pace as an overhang signal.
